name: CsAtcSystem
title: ATC code systems
description: This code system lists the ATC code systems (system URIs) that can be used in MedicinalProductDefinition.classification for products published by UMC terminologies.

concept.definition: The Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system maintained by the WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology.
The Herbal ATC classification system maintained by UMC.
